description: This file defines the Dashboard React component, which manages the main page of the application. It handles uploading data, displaying results in a table, and showcasing a verification sidebar. The component uses React hooks for state management, calls API functions to fetch results, and coordinates other UI components such as UploadPanel, ResultsTable, and VerificationSidebar.

methods.name: Dashboard()
methods.description: React functional component representing the main dashboard page with upload, results, and verification features.

methods.name: handleAnalyzed
methods.description: Handles the results after a file upload or analysis, fetching additional results if necessary, and updating state.

methods.name: onRowSelect
methods.description: Sets the selected row when a user selects a row in the results table.

methods.name: onMark
methods.description: Updates the verification status and note for a specific row locally.
